description: Sleep duration, stages, consistency, balance, recovery, and next-day activity. Nights are assigned to their local wake-up date.

panels.description: Nights whose wake-up time falls inside the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time);

panels.title: Nights

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(avg(value),0) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time);

WITH n AS (SELECT value AS sleep_hours,extract(epoch FROM (coalesce(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'inBedEnd','')::timestamptz,end_time)-coalesce(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'inBedStart','')::timestamptz,time)))/3600 AS in_bed_hours FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time)) SELECT coalesce(avg(100*sleep_hours/NULLIF(in_bed_hours,0)),0) AS value FROM n;
SELECT coalesce(avg(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'deep','')::double precision),0) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time);
SELECT coalesce(avg(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'rem','')::double precision),0) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time);
SELECT coalesce(avg(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'awake','')::double precision),0) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time);

WITH nightly AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',end_time,'$timezone') AS wake_day,sum(value) AS sleep_hours FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time) GROUP BY 1) SELECT wake_day AS time,sleep_hours AS "Sleep duration",avg(sleep_hours) OVER (ORDER BY wake_day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "7-night average",8::double precision AS "8-hour reference" FROM nightly ORDER BY wake_day;

panels.description: Running difference from an eight-hour nightly reference. Negative values indicate accumulated shortfall for the selected range.

targets.rawSql: WITH nightly AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',end_time,'$timezone') AS wake_day,sum(value) AS sleep_hours FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time) GROUP BY 1) SELECT wake_day AS time,sum(sleep_hours-8) OVER (ORDER BY wake_day) AS "Cumulative sleep balance" FROM nightly ORDER BY wake_day;

panels.title: Cumulative sleep balance

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day',end_time,'$timezone') AS time,sum(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'deep','')::double precision) AS "Deep",sum(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'core','')::double precision) AS "Core",sum(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'rem','')::double precision) AS "REM",sum(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'awake','')::double precision) AS "Awake" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: Clock hour uses midnight = 24 so bedtime and wake time share a continuous overnight scale.

targets.rawSql: WITH clocks AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',end_time,'$timezone') AS wake_day,extract(epoch FROM (time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::time)/3600 AS bed_hour,extract(epoch FROM (end_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::time)/3600 AS wake_hour FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time)) SELECT wake_day AS time,CASE WHEN bed_hour<12 THEN bed_hour+24 ELSE bed_hour END AS "Bedtime clock hour",CASE WHEN wake_hour<12 THEN wake_hour+24 ELSE wake_hour END AS "Wake clock hour" FROM clocks ORDER BY wake_day;

panels.title: Sleep schedule consistency

targets.rawSql: WITH sleep_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('day',end_time,'$timezone') AS day FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time)),recovery AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',time,'$timezone') AS day,avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='resting_heart_rate') AS resting_hr,avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='heart_rate_variability') AS hrv,avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='respiratory_rate') AS respiratory,avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='apple_sleeping_wrist_temperature') AS wrist_temp FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('resting_heart_rate','heart_rate_variability','respiratory_rate','apple_sleeping_wrist_temperature') GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.day AS time,r.resting_hr AS "Resting HR",r.hrv AS "HRV",r.respiratory AS "Respiratory rate",r.wrist_temp AS "Wrist temperature" FROM sleep_days s LEFT JOIN recovery r USING(day) ORDER BY s.day;

WITH sleep AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',end_time,'$timezone')::date AS day,sum(value) AS sleep_hours FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time) GROUP BY 1),activity AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',time,'$timezone')::date AS day,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='step_count') AS steps,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='active_energy') AS kcal,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='apple_exercise_time') AS exercise FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('step_count','active_energy','apple_exercise_time') GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.day AS "Wake day",round(s.sleep_hours::numeric,2) AS "Sleep hr",round(a.steps)::bigint AS "Steps",round(a.kcal::numeric) AS "Active kcal",round(a.exercise::numeric) AS "Exercise min" FROM sleep s LEFT JOIN activity a USING(day) ORDER BY s.day DESC;

SELECT (end_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::date AS "Wake date",to_char(time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Sleep start",to_char(end_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Wake time",round(value::numeric,2) AS "Total sleep hr",round((NULLIF(metadata_json->>'deep','')::numeric),2) AS "Deep hr",round((NULLIF(metadata_json->>'core','')::numeric),2) AS "Core hr",round((NULLIF(metadata_json->>'rem','')::numeric),2) AS "REM hr",round((NULLIF(metadata_json->>'awake','')::numeric),2) AS "Awake hr",round((100*value/NULLIF(extract(epoch FROM (coalesce(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'inBedEnd','')::timestamptz,end_time)-coalesce(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'inBedStart','')::timestamptz,time)))/3600,0))::numeric,1) AS "Efficiency %",source AS "Source" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time) ORDER BY end_time DESC;

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month',end_time,'$timezone'),'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",count(*) AS "Nights",round(avg(value)::numeric,2) AS "Avg sleep hr",round(min(value)::numeric,2) AS "Shortest hr",round(max(value)::numeric,2) AS "Longest hr",round(avg(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'deep','')::numeric),2) AS "Avg deep hr",round(avg(NULLIF(metadata_json->>'rem','')::numeric),2) AS "Avg REM hr",round(sum(value)::numeric,1) AS "Total sleep hr" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='sleep_analysis' AND $__timeFilter(end_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC;
